title: Confidence
description: The ONE stated-confidence scale shared by every advocate, step-verifier, and arbiter payload in the external-review pattern, so a stated confidence means the same thing everywhere. This file defines the value domain ONLY. For the arbiter's use, the SEMANTICS (what governs the call) live in the standard-judging constitution. The advocate's and step-verifier's own use of this field is currently just a structural requirement, with no further governing rule stated elsewhere. Referenced by co-located schemas via {"$ref": "confidence.schema.json"}.
